dependency_notes: Choice Scarf is advisory and is not granted or equipped by the builder.
Transform is intentionally the only occupied move slot because filler attacks make Imposter Ditto worse and misrepresent its role.
reviews.doubles_rationale: Imposter immediately copies an opposing threat, scouting its set and turning the opponent's strongest stat line against the field. Transform-only keeps the preset honest and leaves item choice to the player.
reviews.item_context: Choice Scarf is the standard revenge-control option; Focus Sash is a slower alternative when speed control already exists.
reviews.review_notes: Authored exception: unused move slots are intentional.
reviews.role: Imposter revenge copier and information scout

dependency_notes: Focus Sash is advisory and is not granted or equipped by the builder.
All four moves are locally obtainable through Sketch even though ordinary tutor bitfields cannot encode indirect Sketch legality.
Follow Me, Wide Guard, and Fake Out are partner- and matchup-dependent doubles tools.
reviews.doubles_rationale: Fast sleep pressure plus Fake Out creates immediate tempo, while Follow Me and Wide Guard let Smeargle protect either a setup partner or the whole side. Moody supplies a real long-turn payoff without pretending Smeargle is an attacker.
reviews.item_context: Focus Sash is the default because Smeargle's bulk is poor; Mental Herb is a situational anti-Taunt alternative.
reviews.review_notes: Directly reviewed against local Sketch behavior and the doubles support role.
reviews.role: Fast disruptive doubles support and redirection
